name: CaseEmRelativePadding
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "em-relative-padding" (units). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: padding: 1.5em against a 12px font-size
